title: Transferable neural-network preconditioners for Wilson--Clover propagator inversions
abstract: arXiv:2611.20990v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We investigate two single--layer neural-network architectures for accelerating four-dimensional Wilson--Clover propagator inversions on lattice ensembles in practical use; both transfer directly without retraining. The first is a gauge-covariant parallel transport convolution (PTC) network that directly reduces the number of generalized conjugate residual (GCR) solver iterations. The second is a CNN-like network used together with a multigrid-inspired algorithm. The two approaches can be combined to further reduce GCR iterations. PTC transfers without retraining across lattice volumes, lattice spacings, and pion masses while maintaining comparable acceleration, whereas the CNN-like network transfers directly from small- to large-volume ensembles with strong acceleration. A cost comparison accounting for both basis construction and solves shows that the proposed scheme is more advantageous for large-volume ensembles than for small-volum

translated_title: 用于Wilson-Clover传播子求逆的可迁移神经网络预条件器
translated_abstract: 我们研究了两种单层神经网络架构，用于加速实际使用的格点系综上的四维Wilson-Clover传播子求逆；两者均可直接迁移而无需重新训练。第一种是规范协变的平行输运卷积（PTC）网络，可直接减少广义共轭残差（GCR）求解器的迭代次数。第二种是类似CNN的网络，与受多重网格启发的算法结合使用。这两种方法还可以结合，以进一步减少GCR迭代次数。PTC在无需重新训练的情况下，可在不同格点体积、格点间距和π介子质量的系综之间迁移，同时保持相当的加速效果；而类CNN网络可以直接从小体积系综迁移到大体积系综，并带来强劲的加速效果。综合考虑基组构建和求解两方面成本的比较表明，所提出的方案在大体积系综上比在小体积系综上更具优势。
tldr: 该论文提出两种无需重新训练即可跨系综迁移的单层神经网络预条件器（规范协变平行输运卷积网络与类CNN网络），显著减少格点QCD中Wilson-Clover传播子求逆的GCR迭代次数，且在大体积系综上成本优势更为突出。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two retraining-free transferable single-layer neural-network preconditioners (a gauge-covariant parallel transport convolution network and a CNN-like network) that substantially reduce GCR iterations for Wilson-Clover propagator inversions across lattice volumes, spacings, and pion masses, with greater cost advantages for large-volume ensembles.
